existing_derivations.title: New Method for High-Accuracy Determination of the Fine-Structure Constant
existing_derivations.abstract: The von Klitzing constant emerges from the quantum Hall effect. In a 2D electron gas at low temperature and high magnetic field, Hall resistance is quantized in units of h/e².

z_squared_connection: No clear Z² connection found in literature
physical_meaning: Quantum of resistance from quantum Hall effect
mathematical_path: Start from fundamental laws (QFT/GR). Identify relevant Lagrangian. Use perturbation theory or exact solutions. Extract dimensionless ratio.
required_assumptions: No new physics beyond SM at relevant scales
